definitions: to disrupt or sabotage a plan or process
to cause a problem or difficulty
examples: The sudden budget cuts threw a monkey wrench in the works of our project.
Just when everything was going smoothly, he threw a monkey wrench in the works with his unexpected resignation.
lemma: to throw a monkey wrench in the works
synonyms: to put a spoke in someone's wheel
source: to throw a monkey wrench in the works
